goal: Orient Year-2 PHY4605 students to motivation, course journey, materials, workflow and assessment.

deck_context.core_claim: Physical reasoning and independent checks turn computation into defensible evidence.
deck_context.source_summary: Current PHY4605 blueprints and approved 14-slide Week 0 outline. MATLAB prerequisite retention is uncertain; foundations are repaired in Weeks 1–2. Supplied scaffolds support Core learning. Weeks 13–14 are capstone presentations, defence and handoff.

sample_generation_method.repair_mode: edit for a scientific correction, same built-in backend
sample_generation_method.model_config: built-in default, tool does not expose model or quality parameters
sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: view_image inspected local style reference, then referenced_image_paths attached it to built-in tool. Workers inspect approved sample and attach it as style-only.
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Use same built-in tool generation path with style input; repair using same backend if needed. Stop if unavailable.

style.name: Teaching Courseware — Muted Academic Blue + Sage
style.visual_direction: clear, friendly, modern educational slide system with strong hierarchy, approachable labelled diagrams, moderate information density, and restrained semantic colour
style.color_palette: warm white or cool-gray canvas; deep navy #243B53 for titles and structure; dusty blue #6E8FB3 for model content; quiet sage #7AA69B for expected or validated states; muted ochre #C7A35A for occasional prompts or warnings only; subdued coral #BF7A70 only for a real defect or failure
style.typography: projection-readable sans-serif; bold for main titles only; semibold for short headings and key labels; regular for explanatory copy, bullets, sublabels, and notes; italic mathematics where useful; monospaced regular MATLAB code with only the discussed operator emphasised
style.texture_and_finish: flat clean educational finish with pale fills, thin lines, direct labels, simple diagrams, generous alignment, no dark-filled blocks, no gradients, no decorative clutter, and no repeated oversized prompt cards
style.prompt_rule: Ochre/yellow is an optional sparse accent. Use a compact inline prompt, small marker, or no prompt depending on the teaching point; never make a large prompt box a deck-wide requirement.
style.deck_consistency: keep the same palette, typography hierarchy, icon language, spacing, and approachable scientific tone across all slides while varying composition by teaching role

approved_style_reference.role: user-selected layout, visual and writing reference

slides.title: Your journey: learn numerical methods
slides.intent: Introduce one course expectation clearly at low density.
slides.local_context: Four aligned milestones continuing foundation roadmap. Short descriptions: Locate a physical solution; Estimate a rate; Accumulate a quantity; Evolve a state. Use conceptual axes only where clearly labelled Conceptual; prefer non-quantitative small diagrams root crossing, tangent, trapezoid area, sequential state boxes. Do not invent numeric plots. Footer: Compare with a known or supplied reference.

layout.composition: Use slide 6 layout: pale numbered circles with action headings; bold week below, regular topic, scientific diagram, concise caption, thin footer rule and bold navy/sage takeaway. Three columns for slide 8; four for slide 7.

constraints: All copy English and exact; large readable text, one learning object.

No invented numerical graphs or equations. Label conceptual illustrations clearly when needed.
Regular body text; bold title, semibold labels only. No dense paragraphs.
